value.rationale: The entire natural Lucas-shift family of unbounded embedding dimensions is perfect, a structural classification of complement geometry not supplied by published Frobenius/genus/Wilf formulas. A canonical-digit no-strict-peak lemma explains the phenomenon at all indices, contrasting the genuinely different Fibonacci-shift family with isolated gaps. This is not an arbitrary finite slice or a routine substitution.
